verdicts_or_reports.element: Back dismissal with unsaved note content after changing note type
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After entering unsaved Front text, changing the note type, then pressing Back, the editor should ask whether to keep editing or discard the current input, as it does when the type is unchanged.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The editor returned directly to the deck list without a discard prompt, and the unsaved note was lost. With the type unchanged, Back after entering Front text shows “Discard current input?”
steps: Open Add from the deck list.
Leave the note type as Basic and enter “qa-dismiss-test” in Front.
Change the note type to Cloze, then change it back to Basic; Front still displays the entered text.
Press Back once with the keyboard already hidden.
Observe that the app exits to the deck list immediately with no discard prompt and the note is not added.

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes: Completed the filtered deck, add/edit note, and deck options sweep. One confirmed add-note dismissal bug was logged. Temporary filtered deck and note were removed; original deck counts and preset limits are restored.
